code: deadline per band (Nth business day after now, calendar from the policy)
promise date validity (past / after deadline / non-business day)
vague period: ask 1 time(s), then the deadline
amount: full first, floor offer after 'too much' or a below-floor amount, accept floor..full
shared date clamped to each product's deadline
read-back of the whole package, confirmation bound to that package, writes only from the confirmed package
hardship: one code-owned sympathy+support offer, no persuasion afterwards, customer's own date/amount kept
notes per product (used), none after a transfer; close outcome from recorded/transfer/product results
goodbye -> notes -> exactly one close_call in the negotiation path
model: turning the customer's words into events and dates into YYYY-MM-DD (calendar table given)
identity question order, re-asks, declines (bank result routes to the account step)
opening confirmation and its re-ask count
third party, callback window validity and re-ask
transfer decision and queue (close mapping is code)
questions outside payment (robot/scam answers come from the policy)
unsupported_by_code: Interpret 'next <weekday>' as that weekday in the following calendar week and 'this <weekday>' as the current week, relative to now.
A weekend/holiday date not after the deadline is moved to the next business day as an offer (needs customer acceptance).
Without a recorded promise, close reason is that of the first product in get_account order whose note is not paid; paid if all noted paid.
